Releases"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Why BrowserPaw"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"BrowserPaw runs as a Chrome MV3 extension plus a local Native Messaging bridge. It
uses the browser "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"profile you already have instead of copying profile data or
starting a separate automation browser. "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"MCP clients can inspect pages, act with
bounded tools, and verify results without making a remote se"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"rvice the owner of
your browser session."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The project separates three things that are often mixed together:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Static operating guidance** that teaches an agent how to use BrowserPaw.
- **Durable task and pa"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ge ownership**, so parallel work does not silently take
over user pages.
- **Verified site skills**,"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" which are learned from successful tasks and reused
only after independent validation."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## ⚡ What is BrowserPaw?"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"BrowserPaw is a Chrome extension and local MCP server. Its canonical tool names
start with `chrome_*"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"`, while each client may add its own namespace around them.
The default `core` tool profile keeps di"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"scovery small; use
`CHROME_MCP_TOOL_PROFILE=full` or `chrome_tool_docs` when a task needs the wider
"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"small; use
`CHROME_MCP_TOOL_PROFILE=full` or `chrome_tool_docs` when a task needs the wider
surface."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Two execution paths are available:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"1. **Deterministic tools and pipelines** for indexed actions, forms, keyboard,
uploads, downloads, s"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"creenshots, network work, and assertions.
2. **`chrome_act_toward_goal`** for a bounded local percep"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"tion-action loop when
an on-page goal is easier to describe than to decompose into every step."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The persistent `browserpaw repl` exposes the same execution service as small
task, page, locator, sk"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ill, and help interfaces for multi-step code workflows.
It is a documented BrowserPaw subset, not a "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"claim of full Playwright
compatibility."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## 🎯 Key capabilities"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Session reuse** – Runs against the profile already open in Chrome; BrowserPaw
does not copy your"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" browser profile or move credentials into a second browser.
- **Pruned, indexed DOM** – `chrome_read"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"_dom` assigns document-scoped
references and reports action budgets, frame coverage, omitted regions"},{"id":"p14s4","text":", and
truncation. A fast snapshot prioritizes the viewport and interactive targets.
- **Strict, fram"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"e-aware actions** – Explicit frame targets stay within that
frame; ambiguous matches are rejected; n"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ested OOPIF coordinates are projected
through their actual renderer geometry.
- **Card flattening an"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"d viewport virtualization** – `flattenCards` collapses repetitive feed cards into one-line summaries"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"; `virtualizeViewport` folds off-screen list items into count placeholders.
- **Shadow DOM traversal"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"** – Recursively walks open shadow roots; closed shadow hosts are tagged and interacted with at the "},{"id":"p14s10","text":"host level. Accessible names are extracted from icon-only buttons (aria-label, title, SVG titles).
-"},{"id":"p14s11","text":" **Batch and form pipelines** – Run multi-step click/fill/wait/assert/extract
sequences with one mut"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"ation budget and explicit partial or unknown outcomes.
- **Overlay dismissal** – `chrome_dismiss_ove"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"rlay` closes marketing popups, cookie banners, and modals in one step, without dumping the DOM.
- **"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"Delta observations** – Request DOM changes together with an action instead
of paying for a separate "},{"id":"p14s15","text":"full snapshot after every step.
- **Native event fidelity** – Clicks and keystrokes are dispatched a"},{"id":"p14s16","text":"s trusted CDP events (`isTrusted: true`), so React/Vue/Angular and Shadow DOM handlers fire normally"},{"id":"p14s17","text":".
- **Action outcomes** – Results distinguish pre-dispatch rejection, dispatched,
unknown, and verif"},{"id":"p14s18","text":"ied or unverified postconditions. Unknown mutations are never
silently replayed.
- **Coordinate fall"},{"id":"p14s19","text":"back** – When DOM indexing fails (canvas, WebGL, unknown
custom UI), screenshots and `chrome_compute"},{"id":"p14s20","text":"r` provide a documented visual path.
- **Adaptive viewport and screenshot budget** – Owned pages fol"},{"id":"p14s21","text":"low the real
Chrome window size and device pixel ratio instead of a forced 1440×900 frame.

- Single-page goal in natural language → `chrome_act_toward_goal`.
- Long-horizon, multi-"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"page, novel, or escalated situations → the calling agent drives."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Ordinary click, fill and named-target tools resolve targets deterministically first. Supported non-e"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"xact text, label and named-role misses may use one bounded semantic decision when a model is enabled"},{"id":"p19s3","text":". Exact selectors, explicit references, coordinates, frame boundaries and actionability remain stric"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"t. Input values stay separate from target descriptions."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The optional micro-loop remains bounded (default 10, maximum 60 steps). It selects complete action-t"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"arget candidates, stops on uncertain delivery, and requires independent read-only verification befor"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"e reporting completion. Automatic submission is limited to explicitly requested searches on identifi"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ed search controls. External writes return to the calling agent."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Model modes:**"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Off**: No semantic inference or model preload. Deterministic tools remain available; the autonom"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ous micro-loop is hidden from tool discovery and rejects direct execution.
- **Local**: Uses the sep"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"arately installed local decider. Availability, accuracy and performance are evaluated independently "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"from TypeSafe Jev.
- **Remote**: Uses the configured TypeSafe endpoint and model. Set `TYPESAFE_API_"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"KEY` or configure the Native service through the popup. Candidate descriptions and relevant context "},{"id":"p22s6","text":"go to that endpoint; do not put secrets in locator descriptions.
